procedures.title: Testa 12 bar-säkerhetsventilen
procedures.purpose: Följ proceduren för att testa 12 bar-säkerhetsventilen. 1. Öppna dörren på kaffemaskinen. ▪ Servicemenyn öppnas. 2. Se till att spillvattenhinken (en liten hink, inuti den större sumpbehållaren) är torr. 3. Sätt servicenyckeln i dörren. 4. Logga in. ▪ Huvudmenyn visas. 5. Beroende på menyversionen: ▪ A. Tryck på knappen [Maskinvara] och sedan fliken [Testa utlopp]. ▪ B. Rulla ner (använd knappen [Sida ner]) och tryck på knappen [Testa utlopp]. 6. Avslutningsvis, tryck på knappen [Testa 12 bar] för att starta testet. ▪ Pumpen/pumparna kommer att starta omedelbart. Efter en stund aktiveras och öppnas 12 bar-säkerhetsventilen. En liten mängd vatten (se bild) kommer att rinna genom avloppsslangarna och syns i den lilla hinken eller spillvattenhinken i underskåpet. I sådant fall fungerar 12 bar-säkerhetsventilen korrekt. Om inget vatten syns, byt ut 12 bar-säkerhetsventilen. Utbytesproceduren förklaras i nästa kapitel.

procedures.title: How to load a new configuration file from an USB stick
procedures.purpose: The MoVeC files have the extension .mvq. 1. Copy the new file to a USB stick. 2. Insert the USB stick in the USB port of the machine. ▪check the front view drawing and look for the USB port cover. 3. Wait for about half a minute, the machine must read the stick first. 4. Login in the Service Menu. 5. Select the option: Load configuration from USB. 6. Select the available device (most of the times: Device 0). 7. Select the needed configuration on the USB stick. ▪The selected configuration is now loaded and automatically started. 8. Remove USB stick. 9. Ready.

warnings.t: if the coffee machine can not be started properly, create an empty file with the name 'configsetup' on the USB stick. The command forces the machine to load the configuration file and activate the configuration file on the machine.

procedures.title: How to load an IPK or FW files from USB
procedures.purpose: IPK and FW files are used for packaging User Interface files, the MoVeC Application files and other software. 1. Copy the file(s) to an empty USB stick. ▪Make sure the file(s) are placed in the root directory and not in a sub directory. ▪Make sure the file format of the USB stick is FAT32. 2. Open the door of an active machine and insert the USB stick in the USB port inside the door. ▪The machine will recognize the file(s) and upload automatically. 3. Wait approximately 30 seconds until the touchscreen goes black for 2 seconds. ▪In case a FW-file is uploaded the screen will display additional progress information. ▪The software on the machine is now updated. 4. Remove the USB stick. 5. Check the “Software information” from the service menu to make sure the new software version is active.

procedures.title: How to get and load a permission key
procedures.purpose: Collecting coffee machine information 1. Open the door of the machine. 2. The service menu is shown on the screen. 3. Select the “Software information” button on the touchscreen. 4. The Software information screen is shown. 5. Check if the correct software versions are installed: ▪MoVeC ICEQ version :5.3 or higher. ▪Flashfile :3.2 or higher. ▪DJD software ID :9.0 or higher. 6. Within the software information screen, locate the line: IMX6 and write down this number. 7. Write down the complete machine serial number. ▪The machine serial number is 13 character long. (The machine serial number can also be found on the CE sticker inside the machine). 8. Send the IMX6 serial number and the coffee machine serial number to the manufacturer. 9. You will receive a key.mpf file back in return. 10. Save the .mpf file on an empty USB stick. Load the Permissions Follow the procedure below to load and activate the permission key on the DJD coffee machine(s). 1. Select the “load permissions” button. 2. Select the “device 0” button. ▪(device0 = USB Memory stick inside the door) 3. Select the file “xxx_key_xx.mpf” button. ▪browse to the correct map if the USB stick contains maps.

procedures.title: How to calibrate the touchscreen
procedures.purpose: The touchscreen is calibrated in the factory but can be recalibrated with the 'tscalibrate' command. 1. Create an empty file with the name 'tscalibrate' on an empty USB stick. 2. Insert the USB stick in the USB port of the machine. (inside the door). 3. The calibration program starts and will show crosses on the screen in sequence. Four in the corners and one in the middle. 4. Tap the crosses to determine the position of the coordinates on the touchscreen. 5. The machine will restart itself. 6. Check if beverages can be selected. 7. Remove the USB stick. 8. Ready.

procedures.title: Hur man avkalkar kaffemaskinens tank
procedures.purpose: Syfte Beroende på vattenkvaliteten kan kalkavlagringar bildas inuti trycktanken (och ångtanken, beroende på modell), slangar och andra områden av kaffemaskinen. Kalkavlagringar kan skada maskinen och påverka de serverade dryckernas kvalitet. Avkalkningsprocessen avlägsnar kalkavlagringarna. Den totala tiden den tar att kalka av kaffemaskinen är cirka 45 minuter. Detta inkluderar förberedelserna, 10 minuters väntan för att vätskan ska lösa upp kalkavlagringarna och den avslutande sköljtiden för att säkerställa att all avkalkningsvätska och alla kalkrester har avlägsnats från varmvattensystemet. Krävs • Torx 15 skruvmejsel • Avkalkningsvätska • Avkalkningssugslang, tryckslang L = 35 cm, eller en sugslang försedd med en avstängningsventil (se avsnittet om förberedelser) • 1,5 liters mätkärl för blandning av avkalkningsvätskan • Avkalkningsprogrammet är tillgängligt i servicemenyn > Inloggning > Maskinvara > Avkalka • Stor sumpbehållare Intervall Utför följande procedur: • Var sjätte månad, beroende på vattnets kvalitet (hårdhetsgrad) och ytterligare vattenfiltrering Procedur Avkalkningsproceduren är uppdelad i 4 delar för en kaffemaskin av mediummodell med en trycktank: ÅTGÄRD BESKRIVNING TID (min) MÄNGD (liter) Förberedelser blanda vätska, skapa sugs-lang Avkalka mata in avkalkningsvätska blötläggningsperiod avkalk-ning minst 0,6 Sköljning av avkalkningss-lang mata in rent vatten för slang 0.5 Första fullständiga skölj-ningen mata in rent vatten 0,9 bryggenhet 0,2 expansionsventil Andra fullständiga skölj-ningen mata in rent vatten igen samma som föregående steg Framgångsrikt slutförande stäng maskinen Förbereda avkalkningssugslangen 1. Om maskinen är försedd med en slangklämma (3), kan klämman användas som en avstängningsventil. En enkel tryckslang med L = 35 cm maximalt kan föras in i avtappningsslangen (2) och användas som avkalkningssugslang. 2. För kaffemaskiner utan klämma behövs en sugslang med avstängningsventil, som liknar den som visas på bilden. ▪ Förbered slangen och se till att längden (L2) för slangen (4) inte är mer än 30 cm. Delar: 1. Knä. 2. Tryckslang (L1 = 4 cm). 3. Avstängningsventil (visas i "öppen" position) 4. Tryckslang (L2 max 30 cm). Förbered avkalkningsvätska 1. Blanda den rekommenderade mängden* avkalkningsvätska med 1 liter vatten i ett mätkärl. *) Se den utspädningsprocent som rekommenderas av tillverkaren av avkalkningsvätskan. Starta proceduren 1. Stäng av kranen till vattenförsörjningen. ▪ Men se till att maskinen fortfarande är ansluten till vattenförsörjningen. 2. Avlägsna den nedre bakre panelen. 3. Lokalisera avtappningsslangen mellan huvudvattenintaget och pumparna. 4. Avlägsna pluggen från tryckkopplingen/avtappningsslangen. FÖRSIKTIGHET Var försiktig, en liten mängd hett vatten kan läcka ut från kopplingen. 5. Beroende på situation: ▪ Om slangen är försedd med en klämma: sätt in den enkla avkalkningssugslangen i slangen. Lämna klämman stängd. ▪ Om klämman inte används: sätt in knäet för den förberedda sugslangen med avstängningsventil i tryckkopplingen. Se till att avstängningsventilen är STÄNGD. 6. Sätt in den andra änden av avkalkningssugslangen i den förberedda avkalkningsvätskan. 7. Töm spillbrickan och spillbehållaren. 8. Öppna dörren på maskinen och håll den öppen. ▪ Servicemenyn visas. ▪ Sätt inte i servicenyckeln. 9. Placera sumpbehållaren under utloppen. 10. Koppla bort varmvattenslangen i dörren och led även denna slang till sumpbehållaren. Mata in avkalkningsvätska 1. Logga in på servicemenyn. Tryck på knappen [Maskinvara], bläddra ner och tryck på fliken [Avkalka]. 1. Tryck på knappen [Starta] för att starta avkalkningsproceduren. ▪ Den första skärmen för proceduren visas. FÖRSIKTIGHET När vattenkranen inte är stängd kommer vatten att fylla mätkoppen med avkalkningsvätska. 2. Öppna avstängningsventilen/klämman i avkalkningssugslangen. 3. Sätt i servicenyckeln. 4. Tryck på knappen [Nästa]. ▪ Avkalkningsvätskan pumpas in i tankarna och matas ut genom varmvattenutloppet, blandarna, bryggenheten och expansionsventilen. ▪ Meddelandet "Avkalkning pågår. Var vänlig vänta” visas. 5. En vänteperiod (ungefär 10 minuter) påbörjas för att ge vätskan tid att lösa upp kalkavlagringarna. 6. Vänta tills nästa skärm för proceduren visas. 7. Töm sumpbehållaren och spillbrickan. Skölj - rengör avkalkningssugslangen 1. Fyll en hink med 0,5 liter rent vatten. 2. Sätt i avkalkningssugslangen i hinken med rent vatten. 3. I menyn, tryck på knappen [Nästa]. ▪ Avkalkningsslangen sköljs med rent vatten (0,5 liter i 2 minuter) med hjälp av varmvattenventilen. ▪ Meddelandet "Slangsköljning pågår. Var vänlig vänta” visas. 4. Vänta tills nästa skärm för proceduren visas. 5. Avlägsna avkalkningssugslangen från kopplingen. 6. Sätt i pluggen i avtappningsslangen. 7. Om den vita klämman används, stäng klämman. 8. Töm sumpbehållaren och spillbrickan. Skölj 1 - hela systemet 1. Öppna vattenförsörjningen. 2. I menyn, tryck på knappen [Nästa]. ▪ Systemets samtliga vattenutlopp sköljs med rent vatten. ▪ Meddelandet "Sköljning av systemet pågår. Var vänlig vänta” visas. 3. Vänta tills nästa skärm för proceduren visas. 4. Töm sumpbehållaren och spillbrickan. Skölj 2 - hela systemet 1. I menyn, tryck på knappen [Nästa]. ▪ Den fullständiga sköljningen av systemet upprepas. ▪ Meddelandet "Sköljning av systemet pågår. Var vänlig vänta” visas. 2. Vänta tills meddelandet "Avkalkning slutförd" visas. 3. Töm sumpbehållaren och spillbrickan. Framgångsrikt slutförande - tillbaka till normal användning 1. Anslut varmvattenslangen till vattenutloppskopplingen i dörren. 2. Tryck på knappen [Klart] för att slutföra avkalkningsproceduren. 3. Installera maskinens bakre panel. 4. Stäng dörren till maskinen. 5. Gör en testservering eller kör den dagliga rengöringscykeln.

warnings.t: Den öppna tanken ingår inte i detta avkalkningsprogram men kan, om behov föreligger, avkalkas manuellt.

procedures.title: How to create a log file
procedures.purpose: In some cases the support department can request a log file of the coffee machine. The command movecinfo can be used to create a log file. 1. Create an empty file with the name 'Movecinfo' on an empty USB stick. 2. Insert the USB stick in the USB port of the machine (inside the door). 3. The command is recognized, the log file (movecinfo- YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.txt) is created on the USB stick. 4. When finished, the screen will switch off shortly. 5. Remove the USB stick. 6. Ready.

steps.t: Create an empty file with the name 'Movecinfo' on an empty USB stick.
Insert the USB stick in the USB port of the machine (inside the door).

procedures.title: How to descale the boiler of the coffee machine
procedures.purpose: Purpose Depending on the water quality, limescale can build up inside the pressure (and steam - depending on the model) boiler, hoses and other areas of the coffee machine. Limescale can damage the machine and affect the quality of the dispensed drinks. The descaling process removes the buildup of limescale. The total time to descale the coffee machine is about 45 minutes. This includes the preparations, the 10 minute wait for the liquid to dissolve the limescale, and the final rinsing time to make sure all descaling liquid and limescale has been removed from the hot water system. Required • Torx 15 screwdriver • Descaling liquid • Descale suction hose, pressure hose L=35cm, or a suction hose prepared with shut-off valve (see preparation section) • 1.5 liter measuring cup for the descaling liquid mix • Descale program for this model machine on a USB stick Interval Perform this procedure: • Every 6 months, depending on the water quality (hardness) and additional water filtering Procedure The descale procedure is split up in 4 parts for a medium model coffee machine with one pressure boiler: ACTION DESCRIPTION TIME (min) AMOUNT (liter) Preparation create suction hose, mix liquid, load program Descale load descale liquid descale soaking period 0.6 at least Rinse descale hose load clean water 0.5 First full rinse load clean water 0.9 brewer 0.2 expansion valve Second full rinse load clean water same as previous step Successful completion close machine, load config Prepare Descale Suction Hose 1. If the machine contains a hose clamp (3), the clamp can be used as a shut-off valve. A simple pressure hose with L=35cm max. can be inserted in the drain hose (2) and used as a descale suction hose. 2. For coffee machines without the clamp, a suction hose with shut-off valve is needed, similar as shown in the picture. ▪ Prepare the hose and make sure that the length (L2) of hose (4) is not more than 30 cm. Parts: 1. Knee. 2. Pressure hose (L1=4cm). 3. Shut-off valve (shown in 'open' position) 4. Pressure hose (L2 max 30cm). Prepare Descaling Liquid 1. Mix the recommended amount* of descaling liquid with 1 of liter water in a measuring cup. *) Refer to the dilution percentage recommended by the manufacturer of the descaling liquid. Start 1. Remove the lower back panel. 2. Locate the drain hose between the main water inlet and the pumps. 3. Remove the plug from the push-in fitting / drain hose. ▪ Leave the machine connected to the opened water supply. 4. Depending on the situation: ▪ If the hose uses a clamp: insert the simple descale suction hose into the hose. Leave the clamp closed. ▪ If the clamp is not used: insert the knee of the prepared suction hose with shut-off valve in the push-in fitting. Make sure the shut-off valve is CLOSED. 5. Insert the other end of the descale suction hose in the prepared descaling liquid. 6. Empty the drip tray and the waste bucket. 7. Open the door of the machine and keep it opened. ▪ The Service Menu is displayed. ▪ Do not enter the service key. 8. Place a large bucket under the outlets. 9. Disconnect the hot water hose in the door and lead this hose to the large bucket as well. 10. Login in the Service Menu. 11. First check the currently active configuration of the coffee machine: a. From the menu, tap the [Software configurations] button. b. Tap the [Select active configuration] button. c. Note down the currently active configuration, visible in grey (if more then one configuration is available, all non active configurations are yellow). d. Tap the [Back] button to return to the previous menu. 12. Load the descale program for this machine from the USB stick: a. Insert the USB stick with the descale program in the USB port of the coffee machine. b. Tap the [Load configuration from USB] button. c. Tap the [Select (USB)] button to see the contents of the USB stick. d. Tap the [descaling program] button to load the program. The first screen of the descaling program is shown. DESCALING ONLY !!" open the door completely and keep it opened. Do not insert the service key. Inlet descale 1. Close the water supply. 2. Open the shut-off valve / clamp in the descale suction hose. 3. Place the service key. 4. Tap the [Press HERE to start the descale procedure] button. ▪ The boilers are now emptied and the descaling liquid is pumped into the boilers and out, through the hot water outlet, the mixers the brewer and the expansion valve. ▪ The message "Descaling in progress. Please wait" message is shown. 5. A 10 minute waiting period starts to allow the liquid to dissolve the scale. 6. Wait until the next menu is shown. 7. Remove the service key. 8. Empty the bucket and the drip tray. Rinse - clean descale suction hose 1. Fill a bucket with 0.5 liter clean water. 2. Insert the descale suction hose in the bucket with clean water. 3. Insert the service key. 4. From the menu, tap the [Press HERE to rinse the tube] button. ▪ The descale suction hose is rinsed with clean water (0,5 liter for 2 minutes) using the hot water valve. 5. Wait until the next menu is shown. 6. Remove the service key. 7. Remove the descale suction hose from the fitting. 8. Insert the stop/plug in the drain hose. 9. If the white clamp is used, close the white clamp. 10. Empty the bucket and the drip tray. Rinse 1 - full system 1. Open the water supply. 2. Place the service key. 3. In the menu, tap the [Press here to rinse the system] button. ▪ The system is rinsed using all water outputs with clean water. 4. Wait until the next menu is shown. 5. Remove the service key. 6. Empty the bucket and the drip tray. Rinse 2 - full system 1. Place the service key. 2. In the menu, tap the [Press HERE ro rinse the system] button. ▪ The full system rinse will be repeated. 3. Wait until the "Successful" screen is shown. 4. Remove the service key. 5. Empty the bucket and the drip tray. Successful Completion - back to normal operation 1. Remove the USB stick from the machine. 2. Connect the hot water hose to the water outlet connector in the door. 3. Load the original configuration: ▪ tap the [Press HERE to activate] button. ▪ select and tap the [configuration] button that was originally activated in this machine. 4. Test if the configuration is loaded and displayed on the screen. 5. Install the back panel of the machine. 6. Close the door of the machine. 7. Take a test beverage or run the daily cleaning cycle.

procedures.title: How to remove the covers
procedures.purpose: Each cover is secured in two places. A hook at the back (that also acts as a hinge) and two screws on the front inside. To prevent damage to the covers follow the procedure carefully. 1. Open the door of the coffee machine. 2. For the right hand cover, locate the two screws on the right side inside. 3. Remove the screw at the bottom right and the screw in the highest position. Do not remove the cover yet. 4. Remove the two screws on the left inside, to loosen the other cover. 5. To remove the cover, swing it open at the front of the coffee machine but not more than 10 cm. 6. At the back, lift the cover 1 or 2 cm to release the hooks from the slots in the logo plate and remove it. 7. Remove the other side cover in the same way. 8. The top logo plate is secured by two clipping ledges at the top (see inset). Push both ledges to release the logo plate and tilt it out of the machine. 9. The back plate of the machine housing is secured by two screws at the back and two clipping ledges on each side. Remove the two screws. 10. Press both ledges on the left and right side to release them and at the same time pull the back of the housing in the direction of the big arrow.

warnings.t: There are two screws in the top right side. Remove the screw in the highest position. The lower screw secures the hinge of the door and should not be removed (see inset top).

steps.t: Open the door of the coffee machine.
For the right hand cover, locate the two screws on the right side inside.
Remove the screw at the bottom right and the screw in the highest position. Do not remove the cover yet.
Remove the two screws on the left inside, to loosen the other cover.
To remove the cover, swing it open at the front of the coffee machine but not more than 10 cm.
At the back, lift the cover 1 or 2 cm to release the hooks from the slots in the logo plate and remove it.
Remove the other side cover in the same way.
The top logo plate is secured by two clipping ledges at the top (see inset). Push both ledges to release the logo plate and tilt it out of the machine.
The back plate of the machine housing is secured by two screws at the back and two clipping ledges on each side. Remove the two screws.
Press both ledges on the left and right side to release them and at the same time pull the back of the housing in the direction of the big arrow.

procedures.title: How to descale the boiler of the coffee machine
procedures.purpose: Purpose Depending on the water quality, limescale can build up inside the pressure (and steam - depending on model) boiler, hoses and other areas of the coffee machine. Limescale can damage the machine and affect the quality of the dispensed drinks. The descaling process removes the buildup of limescale. The total time to descale the coffee machine is about 45 minutes. This includes the preparations, the 10 minute wait for the liquid to dissolve the limescale and the final rinsing time to make sure all descaling liquid and limescale has been removed from the hot water system. Required • Torx 15 screwdriver. • Descaling liquid. • Descale suction hose, pressure hose L=35cm, or a suction hose prepared with shut-off valve (see preparation section). • 1.5 liter measuring cup for the descaling liquid mix. • Descale program for this model machine on a USB stick. Interval Perform this procedure: • Every 6 months, depending on the water quality (hardness) and additional water filtering. Procedure The descale procedure is split up in 4 parts for a Nio with two pressure boilers or 5 parts for a Nio FM with steam and pressure boiler: # FM ACTION DESCRIPTION TIME (min) AMOUNT (liter) Preparation mix liquid, load program Cool down steam boiler load clean water 0.7 Descale load descale liquid descale soaking period 0.6 at least Rinse descale hose load clean water 0.5 First full rinse load clean water 0.9 brewer + mixers 0.7 hot water outlet 0.9 brewer + mixers 0.2 expansion valve Second full rinse load clean water same as previous step Successful completion close machine, load config Prepare Descale Suction Hose 1. If the machine contains a hose clamp (3), the clamp can be used as a shut-off valve. A simple pressure hose with L=35cm max. can be inserted in the drain hose (2) and used as a descale suction hose. 2. For coffee machines without the clamp, a suction hose with shut-off valve is needed, similar as shown in the picture. ▪Prepare the hose and make sure that the length (L2) of hose (4) is not more than 30 cm. Parts: 1. Knee. 2. Pressure hose (L1=4cm). 3. Shut-off valve (shown in 'open' position) 4. Pressure hose (L2 max 30cm). Prepare Descaling Liquid 1. Mix 10 ml* descaling liquid with 1 liter water in a measuring cup. *) This amount is based on the 4INF010 Descale Liquid, check the actual dilution percentage to create the correct descaling liquid mix. Start 1. Remove the right side panel. Check the section How to remove the covers for more details. 2. Locate the drain hose between the main water inlet and the pumps. 3. Remove the plug from the push-in fitting / drain hose. ▪Leave the machine connected to the opened water supply. 4. Depending on the situation: ▪If the hose uses a clamp: insert the simple descale suction hose into the hose. Leave the clamp closed. ▪If the clamp is not used: insert the knee of the prepared suction hose with shut-off valve in the push-in fitting. Make sure the shut-off valve is CLOSED. 5. Insert the other end of the descale suction hose in the prepared descaling liquid. 6. Empty the drip tray and the waste bucket. 7. Open the door of the machine and keep it opened. ▪The Service Menu is displayed. ▪Do not enter the service key. 8. Place a large bucket under the outlets. 9. Disconnect the hot water hose in the door and lead this hose to the large bucket as well. 10. Login in the Service Menu. 11. First check the currently active configuration of the coffee machine: a. From the menu, tap the [Software configurations] button. b. Tap the [Select active configuration] button. c. Note down the currently active configuration, visible in grey (if more then one configuration is available, all non active configurations are yellow). d. Tap the [Back] button to return to the previous menu. 12. Load the descale program for this machine from the USB stick: a. Insert the USB stick with the descale program in the USB port of the coffee machine. b. Tap the [Load configuration from USB] button. c. Tap the [Select (USB)] button to see the contents of the USB stick. d. Tap the [descaling program] button to load the program. The first screen of the descaling program is shown. DESCALING ONLY !!" open the door completely and keep it opened. Do not insert the service key. Cool down steam boiler (Nio Fresh Milk only) 1. If the coffee machine is not a Fresh Milk (FM) model, skip this section and continue with step 1 in the next section Inlet Descale below. 2. Open the water supply. 3. Make sure the shut-off valve / clamp is closed. 4. Place the service key. 5. Tap the [Press HERE to cool down the boilers] button. ▪The steam boiler will now be filled with cold water. 6. Wait until the next menu is shown. 7. Remove the service key. 8. Empty the large bucket and the drip tray. Inlet descale 1. Close the water supply. 2. Open the shut-off valve / clamp in the descale suction hose. 3. Place the service key. 4. Tap the [Press HERE to start the descale procedure] button. ▪The boilers are now emptied and the descaling liquid is pumped into the boilers and out, through the hot water outlet, the mixers the brewer and the expansion valve. ▪The message "Descaling in progress. Please wait" message is shown. 5. A 10 minute waiting period starts to allow the liquid to dissolve the scale. 6. Wait until the next menu is shown. 7. Remove the service key. 8. Empty the bucket and the drip tray. Rinse - clean descale suction hose 1. Fill a bucket with 0.5 liter clean water. 2. Insert the descale suction hose in the bucket with clean water. 3. Insert the service key. 4. From the menu, tap the [Press HERE to rinse the tube] button. ▪The descale suction hose is rinsed with clean water (0,5 liter for 2 minutes) using the hot water valve. 5. Wait until the next menu is shown. 6. Remove the service key. 7. Remove the descale suction hose from the fitting. 8. Insert the stop/plug in the drain hose. 9. If the white clamp is used, close the white clamp. 10. Empty the bucket and the drip tray. Rinse 1 - full system 1. Open the water supply. 2. Place the service key. 3. In the menu, tap the [Press here to rinse the system] button. ▪The system is rinsed using all water outputs with clean water. 4. Wait until the next menu is shown. 5. Remove the service key. 6. Empty the bucket and the drip tray. Rinse 2 - full system 1. Place the service key. 2. In the menu, tap the [Press HERE ro rinse the system] button. ▪The full system rinse will be repeated. 3. Wait until the "Successful" screen is shown. 4. Remove the service key. 5. Empty the bucket and the drip tray. Successful Completion - back to normal operation 1. Remove the USB stick from the machine. 2. Connect the hot water hose to the water outlet connector in the door. 3. Load the original configuration: ▪tap the [Press HERE to activate] button. ▪select and tap the [configuration] button that was originally activated in this machine. 4. Test if the configuration is loaded and displayed on the screen. 5. Install the side panel of the machine. 6. Close the door of the machine. 7. Take a test beverage or run the daily cleaning cycle.

procedures.title: Requirements
procedures.purpose: Safety Before installing the coffee machine, please read the safety and installation related instructions in the section Safety first. Location Check the section Required installation space to make sure that the coffee machine will have enough space and can be serviced properly. Electrical connection The coffee machine needs to be connected to a power wall socket directly. • The length of the power cable is about 2 m. • Refer to the information on the type plate and check if the wall socket can be used. • Make sure that the wall socket will be accessible after final installation of the coffee machine. Water connection Always use an electric water lock between water tap and coffee machine. • Check the Technical specifications for the minimum required water quality. ▪Use a water filter if the water quality is outside the required values. Internet connection Check if a (wireless) network connection is available. • A network connection is needed to use the Touchless Interface or ConnectMe. • A separate installation manual is available if the machine does not have a network connector. Waste water disposal Check if the coffee machine is prepared to use a fixed waste water connection. • A separate installation manual is available if the machine is not prepared for a fixed waste water connection.

procedures.title: Krav
procedures.purpose: Säkerhet Innan du installerar kaffemaskinen, var vänlig läs instruktionerna för säkerhet och installation som återfinns i avsnittet Säkerhet först. Läge Läs avsnittet Tillräckligt installationsutrymme för att säkerställa att kaffemaskinen kommer att ha tillräckligt med utrymme och kommer att kunna underhållas på korrekt sätt. Elektrisk anslutning Kaffemaskinen måste anslutas direkt till ett vägguttag. • Längden på strömkabeln är ungefär 2 m. • Se information på typskylten och kontrollera om vägguttaget kan användas. • Se till att vägguttaget är åtkomligt efter den slutgiltiga installationen av kaffemaskinen. Vattenanslutning Använd alltid ett elektriskt vattenlås mellan vattenkranen och kaffemaskinen. • Kontrollera de Tekniska specifikationerna för den minsta vattenkvaliteten som krävs. ▪ Använd ett vattenfilter om vattenkvaliteten ligger utanför de värden som krävs. Internetanslutning Kontrollera om en (trådlös) nätverksanslutning är tillgänglig. • En nätverksanslutning behövs för att kunna använda Touchless Interface eller ConnectMe. • En separat installationshandbok är tillgänglig om maskinen inte har en nätverksanslutning. Bortskaffning av spillvatten Kontrollera om kaffemaskinen är utrustad för användning av en fast spillvattenanslutning. • En separat installationsmanual är tillgänglig om maskinen inte är utrustad med en fast spillvattenanslutning.

procedures.title: Before usage
procedures.purpose: 1.1. Installation Installation, transportation and adjustment of the machine is specialized work. Only properly trained service personnel should carry this out. For instructions about transportation, unpacking and installation of the machine, see the technical manual. 1.2. Operation site These machines may only be used indoors, in a hygienic dry room, with a temperature between 5 and 40 degrees Celsius. Place the machine on a flat, stable surface. 1.3. Putting the machine out of order If the machine will not be used for a long period of time (for example during the weekend,) it is recommended to turn off the water supply and the electricity (pulling the plug from the socket is sufficient). This will prevent unnecessary use of energy.

Image of selected beverage Depending on the selected beverage, additional options can be displayed in the submenu to customize the selected beverage. The screen contains at least: The [Order] button. Tap this button to start the preparation of the beverage. This button is disabled when, for instance, payment mode is activated and no full payment is made or if another problem is found that prevents the dispense. Check the displayed message(s) in the message area. The options shown in the submenu depend on the selected beverage, some beverages will have no options at all. The following options are possible for cup and jug dispense: • Canister selection bar: to select an ingredient from a different canister after initial selection. For example, when coffee is selected, it is then possible to select the type of coffee from different canisters. The current selection is highlighted. Depending on configuration and availability of ingredients, a two or three options bar is shown. Tap the desired choice. The following options are possible for cup dispense only: • Strength selection slider: to adjust the amount of coffee ingredient. A longer slider setting means more strength. The slider has five positions, from minimum (Min) to maximum (Max) strength. The default strength is the middle position. Tap one of the two positions to the left for less strength or to the right for more strength. ▪tap the slider for the desired strength. • Add-on selection bar: to add an extra ingredient, for example milk, to the selected coffee. The Add-on selection bar consists of a toggle button and a slider. ▪The default setting is off, no added ingredient. ▪First tap the toggle button once, this enables the slider to set the amount. ▪The slider has three positions. ▪A longer slider setting means more strength. Tap the desired choice. • Cup size selection bar: to select different cup sizes, a two or three options bar can be displayed. The current cup size selection is highlighted. Tap the desired choice. The remaining information on the screen displays: • The currently selected beverage. • The price for the selected beverage. Only visible if payment is activated for the machine. • Credit displays the amount already entered to pay for the selected beverage. Only visible if payment is activated for the machine. • The [Home] button. Tap this button to abort the current selection and return to the Main menu. • The User message area displays relevant procedure messages, for instance 'Place a cup in the center'. • The [Warning/Error message] area. Tap the Warning area to open the Message submenu. Details of all warnings and possible solutions to solve simple issues are listed in the section Messages. • [Language] —optional If more languages are available, a [Language] button is displayed. First, tap the button to show the available languages. Then, tap one of the [Language] buttons to change to the desired language. The screen will show all information in the selected language.

User messages, like 'Place cup in center', are part of the procedure to dispense a beverage and are displayed in a separate user message area. • Tap the [Back] button or tap somewhere in the message area to return to the previous menu. There are several types of messages • disable machine messages, e.g. 'Install drip tray'. When this message is displayed, all selections are disabled and the boiler(s) switched off (for safety reasons). When the drip tray is installed, the boiler(s) are switched on and the selection buttons are enabled. • disable selections messages, e.g. 'Water level 2 too low'. When this message is displayed some or all beverage selection buttons are disabled. When the boilers are filled and the water level is correct the message is removed and the selection buttons are enabled. Details of all messages and possible solutions to solve simple issues are listed in the section Messages.

The prepared drink is ready.

procedures.title: Food safety engagement
procedures.purpose: Food safety and quality are important for both customer and those who work in the vending industry. Respecting a number of basic principles, such as personal hygiene, is essential. We therefore advise you to follow the advice given in "A hygiene guide for vending". This guide is published by the European Vending and Coffee Association and has been prepared to help ensure that a hygienic product is delivered to the customer on every occasion.

procedures.title: Preventive maintenance schedule
procedures.purpose: The schedule below gives an overview of all procedures needed to maintain the coffee machine. warnings.t: Skipping maintenance can affect the quality of the dispensed drink and may lead to malfunctioning of the machine. Clean the coffee machine at the end of the day and before the machine is switched off for a longer period.
If the coffee machine dispenses more than 250 coffee related beverages every day, the brewer should be cleaned with a cleaning tablet every other day.

Fill up the ingredient canisters. 8. Enter canister ingredient levels — optional. 9. Close the door. 10. Clean the outside of the machine. 11. Clean the touchscreen — optional 12. Check correct functioning by taking a test beverage. Each step is described in detail in the next sections.

Tap the button [Place cup and press here] on the screen. ▪Hot water from the boiler flows through the mixers and brewer. 3. A progress screen is shown. ▪Wait until the rinse procedure is finished. ▪Total time to rinse is 1 to 2 minutes. 4. Remove the rinsing tub. 5. The machine returns to the Main menu and is ready for use.

procedures.title: Clean waste bucket
procedures.purpose: Purpose After every dispense, coffee residue (the coffee cake) is moved into the waste bucket. Excess water from the brewer is captured in a drip bucket, placed inside the waste bucket (B). If an external waste bin is used, the waste bucket is replaced by a waste guide (G) in combination with a larger waste water bucket or a fixed connection to the waste water drain. All parts need to be emptied and cleaned regularly. Interval Perform this procedure: • Daily. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Flip up the dispense arm with the outlet nozzles. 2. Depending on the used bucket types: ▪B) Remove the waste bucket (with the drip bucket inside it) from the machine, or ▪G) Remove the waste guide and water bucket from the machine. 3. Rinse the removed parts with clean warm water. 4. Dry parts completely. 5. Install the waste buckets: ▪B) Place the drip bucket inside the waste bucket and install both inside the machine, or ▪G) Place the water bucket on the right side and the waste guide on the left side in the machine. 6. Flip down the dispense arm to the normal position.

warnings.t: If a fixed waste water connection is used, a drip bucket or waste water bucket is not needed.

Depending on the used bucket types: ▪B) Remove the waste bucket (with the drip bucket inside it) from the machine, or

Dry parts completely.

Place the cup stand back in the magnetic suspension point in the door.

procedures.purpose: Purpose If the coffee machine is placed on a base cabinet (or other external cabinet), the internal waste buckets can be replaced by a waste guide and a fixed waste water connection. Remove the waste bin from the base cabinet. 2. Rinse the removed bin with clean warm water. 3. Dry the bin completely. 4. If the coffee machine displays the message 'Waste bucket full / Empty waste bucket', tap the [Reset waste bin] button in the Service menu to reset the counter and remove the message.

Place the jug stand on the guides (2), slide it in the direction of the arrow against the door. (3) fits inside the notch in the door (1).

warnings.t: If the drip tray is connected to a larger waste bucket/bin or directly into the main waste water disposal, the cleaning interval can be lowered to once a week.
Make sure that the ledge on the back of the jug stand

procedures.title: Clean the mixing system
procedures.purpose: Purpose To prevent clogging of ingredients the mixers must be removed from the coffee machine and cleaned. Interval Perform this procedure: • Weekly, increase the frequency if needed Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Remove the outlet hoses from the mixers. 2. Remove the canister outlets and remember the correct position and location of each outlet. 3. Turn the bayonet catches counterclockwise (approx. 10º). 4. Pull the mixer houses in the direction of the arrow and remove them from the machine. 5. Pull the mixer propellers in the direction of the arrow and away from the shaft. 6. Turn the bayonet catches counterclockwise (approx. 10º) again to release and pull them in the direction of the arrow away from the machine. 7. Pull the exhaust filter drawer in the direction of the arrow and remove it from the machine. 8. Remove the exhaust filter from the drawer. 9. Rinse out all removed parts of the mixing system with clean warm water. ▪Make sure to clean the inside of the hoses with a hose cleaning brush and pay attention to inside corners in the hoses. 10. Clean the parts of the mixing system that remain in the machine with a brush. 11. Before continuing with the installation of the mixing system make sure ALL parts are dry. 12. Insert the mixer exhaust filter in the filter drawer. 13. Install the filter drawer. 14. Install the bayonet catches and turn clockwise (approx. 10º). 15. Install the mixer propellers. 16. Install the mixer houses. 17. Turn the bayonet catches clockwise to lock the mixer houses. 18. Install the canister outlets on the canisters and make sure the locations and positions are correct. 19. Connect the outlet hoses to the mixers.

warnings.t: When available, use the clean and dry parts from the hygiene kit. The cleaning of the removed parts can be done after the machine has been put in operation again.
Make sure the exhaust filter is completely dry before installing it in the filter drawer.
Make sure that the arrow on the mixer propeller points in the direction of the flat side of the shaft.
Make sure that the mixer suction trap connects properly to the opening in the filter drawer.

procedures.title: Remove and clean the brewer
procedures.purpose: Purpose For cleaning with water, the brewer must be removed from the coffee machine. The brewer mounting frame needs to be checked and cleaned to prevent malfunctioning of the brewer. Interval Perform this procedure: • At least once a week, increase the frequency if needed. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Open the door, the Service menu is displayed. 2. In the Service menu, tap the [Manual Brewer Cleaning] button. ▪Follow the Manual Brewer Cleaning instructions shown on-screen and described in the next steps. 3. Place the service key in the door. 4. Tap the [Next] button. ▪The brewer will be placed in the manual cleaning position. Wait until the position is set and the message 'The CoEx XL brewer is now ready for manual cleaning' is shown. 5. Remove the service key. 6. Remove the coffee outlet and hose from the dispense arm and clean with warm water. ▪Make sure to clean the inside of the hoses with a hose cleaning brush and pay attention to inside corners in the hoses. 7. Remove the brewer from the coffee machine: place four fingers in the lower grip (1). With your thumb, push and hold down the locking grip (2) and pull the brewer from the mounting frame in the direction of the arrow (3). 8. Place the brewer on a flat surface. Locate the cover release marks on the sides of the brewer cover (see inset). Pull the sides, near these release marks, a few millimeters away from the brewer and lift the cover from the brewer. 9. Clean the brewer with clean warm water (a mild detergent may be used). 10. Place the cover on top of the brewer and push down. Make sure all sides lock. 11. Make sure the inside of the brewer mounting frame in the coffee machine is clean. 12. Insert the brewer into the mounting frame and push the brewer in the direction of the arrow (1) until it locks. Make sure the locking grip (shown in green in the picture) is not pushed in anymore. 13. Install the coffee outlet nozzle in the dispense arm and connect the hose to the connector on the brewer mounting frame. 14. In the Service menu, tap the [Done] button to finish the procedure.

warnings.t: Do not take the brewer itself apart. Only properly trained personnel may work on the brewer itself. Instructions for performing work on the brewer itself is found in the technical manual.
Water and ground coffee (residue) may fall out of the brewer.
When the brewer is not installed correctly, the message ‘Brewer out of position’ is displayed and coffee based dispenses are disabled.

steps.t: At least once a week, increase the frequency if needed. Procedure Perform the following steps:
Open the door, the Service menu is displayed.
In the Service menu, tap the [Manual Brewer Cleaning] button.

Place the service key in the door.

Remove the coffee outlet and hose from the dispense arm and clean with warm water.
Make sure to clean the inside of the hoses with a hose cleaning brush and pay attention to inside corners in the hoses.

Remove the brewer from the coffee machine: place four fingers in the lower grip (1). With your thumb, push and hold down the locking grip (2) and pull the brewer from the mounting frame in the direction of the arrow (3).

Place the brewer on a flat surface. Locate the cover release marks on the sides of the brewer cover (see inset). Pull the sides, near these release marks, a few millimeters away from the brewer and lift the cover from the brewer.
Clean the brewer with clean warm water (a mild detergent may be used).
Place the cover on top of the brewer and push down. Make sure all sides lock.
Make sure the inside of the brewer mounting frame in the coffee machine is clean.
Insert the brewer into the mounting frame and push the brewer in the direction of the arrow (1) until it locks. Make sure the locking grip (shown in green in the picture) is not pushed in anymore.
Install the coffee outlet nozzle in the dispense arm and connect the hose to the connector on the brewer mounting frame.
In the Service menu, tap the [Done] button to finish the procedure.

procedures.title: Clean brewer with cleaning tablet
procedures.purpose: Purpose Cleaning of the brewer with a cleaning tablet removes all coffee residue. The brewer remains in the coffee machine. Required Use the following parts to perform the procedure: • Cleaning tablet. • Rinsing tub or 1 liter jug. • Protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses. • Green service key. Interval Perform this procedure: • At least once a week, increase the frequency if needed. • Total time for the cleaning cycle is 8 minutes. • A message is shown if the brewer is not cleaned after 7 days. • A message is shown and coffee dispense is disabled if the brewer is not cleaned after 9 days. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Open the door, the Service menu is displayed. 2. In the Service menu, tap the [Brewer Cleaning] button. ▪Follow the Brewer Cleaning instructions shown on-screen and described in the next steps. 3. Place a 1-liter jug or a rinsing tub under the outlet. 4. Insert the service key in the door. 5. Tap the [Next] button. ▪The first part of the brewer cleaning procedure starts, wait until the rinse is finished. 6. Tap the [Next] button to place the brewer in the correct position. 7. Wait until the next steps are shown. 8. Drop a cleaning tablet in the brewer. 9. Tap the [Next] button to continue the cleaning procedure. ▪Wait until the cleaning cycle is completely finished (about 8 minutes) and the final part of the procedure is shown. Repeat the full cleaning procedure if the cleaning cycle is not completely finished. 10. Tap the [Done] button to finish the procedure. 11. Remove the service key from the door. 12. Remove and empty the rinsing tub.

warnings.t: Failure to clean the brewer with the recommended cleaning tablet, available from the manufacturer, will void the warranty on related parts. Not cleaning the brewer can cause the machine to malfunction! Our advice is to do this at least once a week.
S
Wear protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses when working with cleaning tablets.
Never cancel or interrupt the cleaning cycle.

procedures.title: Clean the tea brewer
procedures.purpose: Purpose Cleaning of the tea brewer removes all residue. To clean the tea brewer, it needs to be removed from the coffee machine. Interval Perform this procedure: • Weekly. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Open the door. 2. Remove the brewer from the bracket. ▪Push down and hold the bottom part of the bracket (A). ▪Tilt the tea brewer in the direction of the arrow (B) to release it from the bottom fixation of the bracket. ▪Lower the brewer (C) out of the top fold of the bracket. 3. Remove the hose from the dispenser arm. 4. Disassemble the tea brewer. 5. Clean all parts, including the hose, with warm water. 6. Assemble the tea brewer. 7. Install the brewer. ▪Position the brewer inside the top fold of the bracket (A). ▪Push the lower part of the brewer inside the bracket (B) and make sure it locks properly in position. 8. Insert the hose in the dispenser arm.

procedures.title: Fill up the cup dispenser — optional
procedures.purpose: Purpose Follow this procedure when the machine contains a cup dispenser. In order to prevent that the machine can no longer dispense drinks due to a lack of cups, the machine must be refilled in time. Required Use the following parts to perform the procedure: • Paper or plastic cups for coffee machines (diameter 70 mm or 73 mm). Interval Perform this procedure: • When needed. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Open the door of the machine. 2. On the inside of the door flip up the locking lever of the cup dispenser door. 3. Open the cup dispenser door. 4. Place the new cups in the dispenser door. ▪A maximum of three stacks of cups is possible. Start filling with the stack on the right side. 5. To prevent damage to the cups do not stack them higher then the top support plate. Remove all cups visible above the support plate. 6. Close and lock the dispenser door.

warnings.t: It is always possible to place a cup by hand.
Be careful when opening the cup dispenser door. Cups can fall out.

procedures.title: Place new filter paper
procedures.purpose: Purpose Follow this procedure when the machine runs out of paper and a new roll of filter paper must be placed. Required Use the following parts to perform the procedure: • Green Service key. • Roll of recommended coffee filter paper. Interval Perform this procedure: • When needed. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Open the door of the machine. 2. Insert the service key in the door. 3. In the Service menu tap the [Replace filter paper] button. ▪Wait until the brewer chamber has moved to the open position. 4. Remove the service key from the door. 5. Remove the old filter paper from the brewer. ▪Lift the transport wheels with the cantilever if needed. 6. Place the new roll of filter paper. 7. Guide the filter paper to the brewer around the guiding wheels (6). 8. Lift the transport wheels (2) with the cantilever if needed. 9. Insert the service key in the door. 10. In the Service menu tap the [Replace filter paper] button. ▪The brewer moves a cycle and stops. 11. Check if the filter paper is being transported correctly and that no folds or creases are in the paper. 12. Remove the service key from the door. 13. Check the functioning of the machine by taking a test drink (coffee).

warnings.t: Make sure the filter paper roll unrolls counter clock wise.
Make sure that the brewer is not moved down during lifting of the transport wheels. Push the cantilever down with your thumb while supporting the brewer with your index finger.

procedures.title: Clean the canisters
procedures.purpose: Purpose All ingredients leave residue inside the canister. To clean the canisters they need to be removed from the machine. Interval Perform this procedure: • Monthly, increase the frequency if needed Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Open the door. 2. Open the top lid of the coffee machine. 3. Remove the canisters from the machine. ▪Check the first steps in the section Fill up the ingredient canisters for more details about the removal of the canisters. 4. Unlock (optional) and remove the lid from the canisters. 5. Empty the canisters. 6. Clean the canisters with warm water. 7. Dry the canisters thoroughly on the inside and outside. The product may form lumps which makes the system unusable.

warnings.t: To prevent possible activation of the machine, never place the service key.
Use a mild detergent if warm water only is not sufficient.
Do not fill the canisters until they are completely dry.

procedures.title: Clean the cold water outlet nozzle — optional
procedures.purpose: Purpose The cold water outlet nozzle must be cleaned regularly to prevent bacteria growth. Required Use the following parts to perform the procedure: • Multi purpose, disposable cloth. • Cleaning agent. • Disposable paper towels. • Rinsing tub or 1 liter jug. • Protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses. Interval Perform this procedure: • Weekly, increase the frequency if needed (depending on machine usage and environmental conditions) Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Use the cloth to apply the cleaning agent. Submerge a clean cloth into the cleaning agent (concentration recommended by cleaning agent manufacturer’s instructions). Remove the cloth and remove excess water. 2. Clean the cold water outlet nozzle wiping the cloth over the entire area re-submerging the cloth as necessary. 3. Rinse the cloth in clean warm water and wipe off excess cleaning agent residue and soil. 4. Dry cold water nozzle using disposable paper towels. 5. Close the door of the coffee machine. 6. Place a rinse tub below the cold water outlet nozzle. 7. Leave the Service menu: Tap the [Exit] button and then the [OK] button to answer the question 'Do you want to leave the service menu' to leave the Service menu. 8. Select a full jug of cold water and dispense at least 1 liter of cold water and ensure any cleaning residue is flushed out.

warnings.t: Do not use aggressive cleaning products or abrasives to clean (parts of) the machine.
Wear protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses when working with cleaning chemicals.

procedures.title: Deep clean the cold water outlet nozzle — optional
procedures.purpose: Purpose The cold water outlet nozzle must be cleaned and disinfected regularly to prevent bacteria growth. Required Use the following parts to perform the procedure: • Multi purpose, disposable cloth. • Cleaning agent. • Protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses. • Disinfectant solution. • Disposable paper towels. • Rinsing tub or 1 liter jug. • Brush. Interval Perform this procedure: • Monthly, increase the frequency if needed (depending on machine usage and environmental conditions) Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Submerge a clean cloth in warm water. Pre clean the cold water outlet nozzle using the cloth. 2. Submerge a clean cloth into the cleaning agent (concentration recommended by cleaning agent manufacturer’s instructions). Remove the cloth and remove excess water. 3. Clean the cold water outlet nozzle wiping the cloth over the entire area re-submerging the cloth as necessary. 4. Using a brush, brush around the cold water nozzle to dislodge any dried on soil. Remove the soil with a cloth. 5. Soak a clean disposable cloth in clean warm water and rinse the outlet nozzle until all soil and cleaning agent residues are removed. 6. Soak a clean disposable cloth in disinfectant solution, ensure that the whole area is wiped. 7. Leave for 10 minutes. 8. Rinse off disinfectant using disposable cloth in clean warm water. 9. Dry cold water nozzle with disposable paper towels. 10. Close the door of the coffee machine. 11. Place a rinse tub below the cold water outlet nozzle. 12. Leave the Service menu: Tap the [Exit] button and then the [OK] button to answer the question 'Do you want to leave the service menu' to leave the Service menu. 13. Select a full jug of cold water and dispense at least 1 liter of cold water and ensure any cleaning residue is flushed out.

warnings.t: Do not use aggressive cleaning products or abrasives to clean (parts of) the machine.
Wear protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses when working with cleaning chemicals.

procedures.title: Fill up the ingredient canisters
procedures.purpose: NOTE • Make sure that the canisters remain filled with a layer of at least 4 cm of product. • Only use ingredients recommended by the supplier of the machine. • To fill up a bean canister (optional) check the section Fill the bean canister. Purpose To prevent that the machine can no longer dispense drinks due to a lack of ingredients, the machine must be refilled in time. Required Use the following to perform the procedure: • Ingredients. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Open the door. WARNING To prevent possible activation of the machine, never place the service key. 2. Open the top lid of the coffee machine. 3. Remember (or write down) the position of the outlets and turn the outlets of the canisters upwards. 4. Slightly lift the canister at the front until the small locking ridge (see inset) is visible. 5. Pull the canister towards you and take it out of the machine. 6. Remove the lid and place the canister on a stable surface. 7. Fill the canister with the ingredient indicated on the canister. 8. Place the lid back on the canister and position the canister back into the machine. 9. Turn the outlets of the canister downwards. 10. Close the top lid of the machine.

warnings.t: Filling the canisters must be done outside the machine.
Do not fill the canisters more than necessary for one or two days. This will keep the products fresh.
Make sure the drive at the back of the canister fits well on the motor drive.
Check the position of the outlet of the canister. It must be positioned towards the correct mixing bowl.

procedures.title: Fill up the bean canister
procedures.purpose: NOTE • Make sure that the canisters remain filled with a layer of at least 4 cm of product. • Only use ingredients recommended by the supplier of the machine. • To fill up an ingredient canister (optional) check the section Fill up the ingredient canisters. Purpose In order to prevent that the machine can no longer dispense drinks due to a lack of ingredients, the machine must be refilled in time. Required Use the following to perform the procedure: • Coffee beans. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Open the door. 2. Open the top lid of the coffee machine. 3. Locate the canister locking slider in between the grinder and the bean canister. 4. Pull the canister locking slider in the direction of the arrow. The bean canister will be closed and unlocked from the grinder base. 5. Lift the bean canister from the grinder base and take it out of the machine. 6. Place the bean canister on a stable and flat surface for refilling. 7. Unlock the lid (optional). Lift the lid in the front and then pull the lid from the canister in the direction of the arrow. 8. Fill the canister with fresh coffee beans. 9. Place the back side of the lid on the canister and then lower the front side. Lock the lid (optional). 10. Place the bean canister back into the coffee machine on the four position ridges of the grinder base. 11. Push the canister locking slider back in the direction of the arrow to open the bean canister and secure it to the grinder base. 12. Repeat the procedure if more bean canisters must be filled up.

Filling the canisters must be done outside the machine.

procedures.title: Enter canister ingredient levels — optional
procedures.purpose: Purpose When activated the coffee machine displays a message 'Canister % almost empty' when the ingredient canisters are almost empty. Based on the number of beverages taken, the machine calculates the amount of ingredients left in the canisters. When the canisters are filled up the counters need to be reset. Follow the steps in the procedure below to reset the counters. Interval Perform this procedure: • When this option is active, the Enter ingredient level screen is displayed when the door is opened. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. When the door is opened, the Enter ingredients levels screen is displayed. ▪The current fill level of each canister is displayed (only the fill levels of the canisters activated for this option are shown). 2. To change a canister fill level, first tap the [Edit fill levels] button (A) on the screen. ▪or tap the [Exit] button to leave the Service menu. 3. Fill level sliders are shown for each activated canister. Tap the level or move the slider to the correct fill level. 4. Repeat the previous step for each canister that is filled up (or where the shown value is not correct). 5. Tap the [Save fill levels] button (B) to save the current setting. 6. Tap [Exit] to leave the Service menu.

warnings.t: A completely filled canister is filled 100%. To keep ingredients fresh it is also possible to fill the canister for 50%.

procedures.title: The service key
procedures.purpose: Purpose For safety reasons all dispense functions are disabled if the door of the machine is opened. Use the green service key to override this safety for maintenance procedures that need a fully functioning machine.

procedures.title: Insert the service key
procedures.purpose: Required Use the following parts to perform the procedure: • Green service key. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Locate the entry for the Service key on the inside of the door. 2. Insert the Service key in the service key entry. 3. Turn the Service key a quarter turn (90°). ▪The grey options in the Service menu change to yellow/ green. ▪The coffee machine is now fully functional with an open door. ▪The key remains locked in the entry.

warnings.t: When the service key is inserted, the machine is powered up with open door. Parts in the machine can move and hot water can flow out. Only insert the service key when requested.

steps.t: Green service key. Procedure Perform the following steps:

Insert the Service key in the service key entry.
Turn the Service key a quarter turn (90°). ▪The grey options in the Service menu change to yellow/ green.
The coffee machine is now fully functional with an open door.
The key remains locked in the entry.

procedures.purpose: Required Use the following parts to perform the procedure: • Green service key. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Turn the Service key a quarter turn (90°). 2. Remove the Service key from the door.
